headline: Tools multiply human capability—they let us do what our bodies alone cannot
universal_truth: Leverage is the human superpower; the right tool makes the impossible possible
fun_facts: The oldest known tools are 3.3 million years old—tool use predates modern humans
A lever can multiply your force by 10x or more—a child can lift a car with the right setup
The plow was so important that it enabled civilization itself—farming requires tools
discussion_questions: What could you accomplish with better tools?
Where are you trying to solve a tool problem with effort?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Humans are not the strongest, fastest, or toughest animal. But we dominate the planet. Our superpower? Tools. A lever multiplies force. A wheel multiplies speed. Tools let us exceed our biological limits.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Tools aren't just physical—mental models, systems, processes are tools too. What makes tools so powerful?

options.text: Tools provide leverage—they multiply your input into greater output, letting you achieve results disproportionate to effort
options.response: Yes. A hammer multiplies the force of your arm. A computer multiplies the speed of calculation. Leverage is the magic—small input, large output.
True, but more specifically—tools provide leverage, amplifying what you put in...

q1.title: Simple Machines
q1.script: The six simple machines—lever, wheel, pulley, inclined plane, wedge, screw—all provide mechanical advantage. They trade one thing for another: distance for force, speed for power. Understanding them is understanding leverage.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Simple Machines"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Tool Progression
q2.script: Human history is tool history. Stone tools to bronze, to iron, to steam, to electricity, to digital. Each era's tools define its possibilities. Better tools, better capabilities.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Mental Tools
q3.script: Tools aren't just physical. Writing is a tool for memory. Math is a tool for reasoning. Frameworks are tools for thinking. The right mental tool multiplies cognitive capability just like physical tools multiply physical capability.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Leverage is the human superpower. The right tool makes the impossible possible. Invest in tools—physical and mental.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 229. Tomorrow, we'll explore going up—elevation and scaling heights. Until then, identify one tool that would multiply your effectiveness.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Tool Audit - What Multiplies You?
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify and invest in high-leverage tools
growTrack.activity: What tools—physical or mental—multiply your effectiveness? Where are you using raw effort when a tool would help? Investing in the right tool can return far more than the investment. Leverage beats effort.
